verdict.rationale: Scribe's batch mode handles large-scale work: up to 10,000 files per job, files processed independently, and a job lifecycle that includes a QUEUED state with list and status endpoints. However, no concurrency limits, parallel-job caps, rate limits or queue semantics (ordering, wait times, throttling) are documented. missing for 10: documented concurrency limits on parallel jobs or requests, documented queueing behavior beyond a QUEUED state label, independent or hands-on corroboration of parallel throughput.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run many transcription jobs in parallel, with concurrency limits and queueing behavior documented

citations.quote: Transcribes up to 10,000 audio files in a single job, or 1,000 files from a manifest
Jobs expose QUEUED, PROCESSING, SUCCEEDED, PARTIAL, FAILED, and CANCELED states
